_about: The one place GenClass plans are defined. telemetry-worker/src/plans.ts imports this file (limits, entitlements, Stripe lookup keys, the billing page) and site/build.py reads it (the pricing page). scripts/stripe-setup.mjs creates the Stripe products and prices from it. Prices are US cents. A null yearly price means no yearly option yet. limits.apps null means no plan limit (the worker still caps an account at 200 apps against abuse). Feature lines with available false are shown as coming next.
footer: Need self-hosting, SSO or invoices? Email mehar@daybot.ca.
